notes.title: 東方霊守祀　～ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites New Trial Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
東方霊守祀　～ Consciousness' Unity of Opposites New Trial Version Now Available!

Note: This update will make all existing player archives and replays unavailable, so be sure to make a backup if needed.

Here are the details of this update:

Characters:
1. When waves wash away snow and ice and maple leaves fall - Miyako Yoshika, now available as a playable-character! Includes typeA and typeB for play.
2. Hakurei Reimu typeA: Increased the horizontal hit determination of the Sealing Needle, and canceled the sub-option highlights.
3. Hakurei Reimu typeB: Replaced the bomb texture, modified the spread angle of bullets in low-speed mode, and increased the firepower of the front and bottom; increased the judgment of bullets, and canceled the highlights of the sub-option.
4. Kirisame Marisa typeA: Modify the player character texture, increase the laser horizontal hit determination, increase the movement speed of the spirit strike circle when releasing the spirit strike, and optimize the problem of delayed following of the sub-option.
5. Kirisame Marisa typeB: replace the bomb texture, modify the texture of the player character texture and the sub-option; increase the bullet hitting and blowing up judgment in low speed mode, increase the time of the blowing up judgment, and slow down the sub-option following speed greatly; increase the moving speed of the spirit striking circle when releasing the spirit striking, and collect the sub-option to the side when stopping the shooting.

Procedures:
1. Adjusted the release of the player character bomb, now releasing the bomb requires pressing the spell card key twice within a period of time after the sun-pattern value reaches 100%.
2. Adjusted the dematerialization effect of the bomb.
3. Adjusted resource values.
4. Adjusted score item and score.
5. Increased the graze judgment range of the player character.
6. Fixed problems related to the pause menu option.
7. Fixed the problem that storing replay would cause an error under special circumstances.
8. Optimized menu response speed.
9. Optimized resource loading speed.

Levels (defaults to full difficulty if not specified) :
1. Global Stage: Adjusted the graze rank of the spell cards in the stage 1-3; adjusted the appearance position of some of the enemy in the stage 1-3.
2. Stage 1: Replaced the BGM in the stage 1, and correspondingly adjusted the appearance time and location of some enemy in the stage 1. Stay in the sweet snowy scenery!
3. Stage 2: Adjust the last enemy in Part5 to eliminate bullets after defeating it; Fixed an anomaly in Jade's judgment at the laser connection of the first spellcard of the boss at the bottom of the level. Adjusted the difficulty of the third spell card of the boss at the bottom of the Lunatic difficulty level.
4. Stage 3: Adjusted the type and density of bullets fired by enemies in parts 2 and 4.

Features:
1.English is now supported! English language has been added, and can be switched by the language setting option.
2.Added Player Data option, where you can view scores and spellcard captured during the game.
3.Added Story option where background story and character stories can be viewed.
4.Spell Practice has added a screenshot system, whereby players will be able to capture spell cards and then display a screenshot of their gameplay on the card's interface. Also, the decorations around the spell card screenshots will vary depending on the player's graze rank at the time of collecting the spell card.
5.Spell Practice added non-spell practice now, which can be switched using the Shift key.
6.Changed the description text in Manual.

Visual and Auditory effects:
1. Replaced all sound effects.
2. Replaced some item textures.
3. New visual settings in Option, where you can adjust the display of background, shadow, bar and power-up effects.
4. Added a special animation effect for the enemy character when declaring a spell card.
5. A new spell card graze progress bar has been added, located underneath the card name. Each time a player completes a graze time, the progress bar will change color and start from the beginning, accompanied by a sound effect.
6. Replace the fonts and colors of some texts, and high-definition some textures.
7. Modified the visual effect when activating the red dango ability.
8. Modified the hiding effect for players near the bottom dango slot during gameplay.
9. Fixed the display of the hi-score.
10. Fixed the display order of enemy character UI.
11. Fixed the real time of spell card settlement.
